newsitem.title: USA: Standard Fed to launch Detroit investment.
newsitem.headline: Standard Fed to launch Detroit investment.

text.p: Standard Federal Bank on Monday announced plans to establish a $203-million loan commitment package in Detroit to support the city's Community Action Plan through 1998.
Standard Federal said the new funding will help increase the available housing stock and provide opportunities for low- and moderate-income residents to buy houses in Detroit.
The bank, a unit of Standard Federal Bancorporation Inc, has already sponsored a housing subdivision in the community of Victoria Park, which it cited as sparking a housing renaissance in Detroit.
